claims.assertion: Yazhi interprets toy imagery—trees, butterfly wings, pink hair, owls, and unicorns—as signals of Cabal enslavement, sacrifice, or sexual exploitation.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She says the imagery is beautiful when viewed in isolation.

claims.assertion: Yazhi says teddy bears and unwinnable zombie-game loops encode ritual sacrifice and train players in helplessness; she also describes a game ritual involving a pentagram and butterfly.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: These are her interpretations of films and games.

proposed_topics.name: Ritual symbolism in toys and media
